desc: Derive and verify the incremental recurrence: for fixed modulus d, when extending the right end from j-1 to j, every substring's remainder transforms as r -> (r*10 + digit) % d, plus the new single-char substring with remainder digit % d.
Decide approach: single pass maintaining nine remainder-counters simultaneously, O(45n) time, O(45) memory (avoids modular-inverse pitfall for d sharing factors with 10).
Implement single-pass solution with cnt = [[0]*d for d in range(10)]; per char x: rebuild each nxt[d], add length-1 substring, if x>0 accumulate nxt[x][0].
Validate against examples ("12936" -> 11, "5701283" -> 18, "1010101010" -> 25) and edge cases: all zeros ("000" -> 0), single non-zero digit (-> 1), single zero (-> 0), length 10^5 performance.
Write final solution in the given starter code with brief comments and complexity analysis.
